That might mean finding products faster, selling more consistently, connecting online and store activity, or giving the team better information to act on. steps.plain_text_content: Practical AI Could your team find the right product faster? Hello {{first_name}}, AI becomes useful when it removes a real step from the work. For a jewelry team, that may be finding the right product by keyword, conversation, or image while a customer is still engaged. The GIS247 Faro AI feature is a practical place to explore that idea.
